name: Valverde Sintra Palacio de Seteais
positioning: Valverde Sintra Palácio de Seteais: a historic palace hotel in Sintra with period furniture, garden and pool, and hosted visits to the Pena National Palace
best_for: Travelers who want to stay in a historic palace with period furniture
Visitors keen on Sintra's Pena National Palace and Portuguese royal history
Guests who want afternoon tea, a picnic or an afternoon at the spa

facts.text: The hotel's setting evokes a chapter in the history of Portugal, with its court parties and aristocratic eccentricities.
Rooms keep the same furniture as in the past.
The Royal Suite's decor is inspired by the 18th and 19th centuries, with Dona Maria-style furniture.
The Royal Suite has a living room, an open-plan office, a relaxation area and a balcony, with views over the pool and the palace gardens.
Each Signature Suite has a marble bathroom with a separate bathtub and walk-in shower.
Classic Rooms are in the former palace wing, look over the hotel gardens and come with a double bed.
Deluxe Rooms come with either a double bed or twin beds and a bathroom with either a bathtub or a shower.
The restaurant and bar serve recipes from Portugal and the world.
The hotel has a pool and garden.
The staged Pena Palace visit is designed for a small group.
The hotel offers an outdoor picnic, charged per person.

highlights.text: Some Signature Suites have welcomed guests including Eça de Queiroz and Agatha Christie.
The hotel offers a staged visit to Pena Palace with actors, centred on the private chambers of Queen Amélia.
Signature Suites are on the first floor of the palace, with views over the swimming pool or the Sintra valley extending to the Atlantic Ocean.
Afternoon tea is served at five o'clock, with menus paying tribute to Catherine of Braganza and Carlota Joaquina.
The Pena from Within visit explores the Pena National Palace's architecture, symbolism and landscape at a slower pace.

considerations.text: Classic Rooms come with a double bed and look over the gardens; Deluxe Rooms offer a choice of a double bed or twin beds.
Signature Suite views differ: some look over the swimming pool, others over the Sintra valley toward the Atlantic Ocean.
WhataHotel notes the historic building may have older infrastructure.
